ev.q: Fourteen (12%) of the 115 persons required hospital admission.
Twenty persons (17%) had musculoskeletal injuries related to falls or altercations
Twenty-eight (24%) of the 115 sought care for apparent infections
Surveillance for injuries and diseases was conducted at the 15 hospitals and clinics within a 75-mile radius

methods_quotes.q: Telephone calls to all ED directors were made at the end of the surveillance period to verify data completeness.
ED staff asked all persons seeking care at their facility whether they were affiliated with the gathering
